title: SEKTION wall cabinet
description: SEKTION wall cabinet, white/Havstorp light gray, 12x15x30" SEKTION kitchen system gives you endless possibilities to design your dream kitchen. Paired with HAVSTORP fronts in a timeless light grey tone you get a modern clean look that feels neutral and harmonious. (193)
features: To be finished with legs and plinth, sold separately.
Different wall materials require different types of fasteners. Use fasteners suitable for the walls in your home.
The hinge is adjustable in height, depth and width.
Requires a knob or a handle
To be completed with SEKTION suspension rail for mounting the cabinet to the wall.
materialAndCare: Fiberboard, Acrylic paint; Frame: Particleboard, Melamine foil, Plastic edging; Back: Fiberboard, Acrylic paint; Steel, Nickel plated; Particleboard, Melamine foil, Plastic edging
